home.title: I'm FullStack Developer
home.body: Hi! I'm Nadia Antonella Ruiz. I'm a final-year student in the University Technical Program in Programming at UTN. I've worked on projects using technologies like React, Express.js, MongoDB, and more. My focus is on creating solutions that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

about.title: About me
about.body: I'm passionate about technology and how it can have a positive impact on people's lives. For me, innovation is a way to transform society, emotions, and mindsets. I enjoy combining technical and soft skills because I believe that the balance between the two makes all the difference.
about.body2: I enjoy cooking and reading; these activities help me connect with myself and keep my mind creative. I also enjoy listening to music and practicing yoga three times a week.
about.body3: I consider myself naturally curious. I enjoy learning, exploring new ideas, and sharing what I know. I believe that personal and professional growth go hand in hand, and I try to live by that mindset.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.piaceresDesc: Multi‑page informative website for a restaurant, showcasing menus, services, and contact details. Built with a responsive design using JavaScript, CSS, and HTML, providing a clean and engaging user experience.
portfolio.reedDesc: Website with a dynamic product catalog and user authentication. Built with a connected frontend and backend, including signup, login, and token‑based security. Developed using React, Vite, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML, with responsive design and product listing features.
portfolio.ruizDesc: Informative landing page for an accounting firm, featuring a contact form that sends client details directly to email. Designed initially with Loveable and further developed using TypeScript, CSS, and HTML for a responsive and professional layout.
portfolio.legalDesc: Website with client and case management, dynamic task tracking, and user authentication. Built with a connected frontend and backend, including signup, login, and token‑based security. Developed using ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, PostgreSQL, and React + Vite.
